plan.title: SRC-ACT-005 Order Activity Edit Evaluation Time

steps.note: Create a controlled event for the activity-history test.
Use an RFQ stage because Edit Evaluation Time is a stage Settings action.
Configure the RFQ stage before its stage-specific actions.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the required line item for the pricing sheet.
Commit a schedule so the event can be published.
Add one QA test vendor required for publishing.
Confirm the event reached a real project page before editing evaluation time.
Perform the Edit Evaluation Time action that should create the activity record.
Open the RFQ stage's Activity drawer from Settings.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer opened.
Assert that Order Activity contains the new Edit Evaluation Time entry.
Confirm an earlier activity entry remains visible rather than being replaced.
